label: copy-phase input f (fed-back f), from the 4th output onward
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L) when the fed-back input token is the letter f, i.e. the model just output f and is now producing the next original token. Never fires in the original phase or at <DEL>, and almost never on any other input token. Activation is weak or absent early in the copy (recall_idx 1-2, rate about 1%) and becomes reliable from recall_idx >= 3 (about 98% precision); magnitude grows with how far into the copy phase the step is, with the top activations around recall_idx 5-6. When f appears twice in a row, the second copy-phase f is usually somewhat weaker than the first. The output token, previous tokens and sequence length have no visible effect beyond this position dependence.

issues: The claim 'at recall_idx 1-2 the rate is about 1%' is wrong. On dev, with in_tok==f in the copy phase, precision is 0.000 at recall_idx==1 (n=16650) and 0.235 at recall_idx==2 (n=16766), not about 1%.

The recall_idx==2 behaviour depends strongly on L. Precision at recall_idx==2 for L=3..9 is 0.35, 0.72, 0.36, 0.13, 0.08, 0.07, 0.11. At L=4 it fires 72% of the time. This is the main systematic class of misses: in the test misses, every listed missed activation is a fed-back f at recall_idx 2 (f was original token 1), mostly with L=4 or 5.

The recall_idx>=3 onset also shows a small L effect. Precision at recall_idx==3 is 0.97/0.99/0.96 for L=4/5/6 and 0.93/0.92/0.94 for L=7/8/9. The test false positives are f as original token 2 replayed at recall_idx 3 with L=6-8, and at recall_idx>=4 precision is 0.997 or higher.

The other claims check out. The feature has zero activations in the original phase and at <DEL>. Of all activations, 60518 of 60529 are on in_tok f. Repeated f (prev_tok==f) still fires, at precision 0.974. Mean magnitude per active step rises from recall_idx 3 to 5 and then levels off from 5 to 8, so it is not a peak at 5-6. The test scores reproduce: P 0.986, R 0.936, F1 0.960, mass recall 0.987.
Adding the L=4, recall_idx==2 case gives test P 0.976, R 0.965, F1 0.970, mass recall 0.994. That is a small but real gain.
